slides.title: 6 notes to keep from No Nut November [[— your p*rn playbook for December.]]
slides.sub: 8 days left. Memory fades. Paper doesn't.

slides.title: Write [[1–3]]
items: Your riskiest hours — when p*rn urges hit hardest.
What worked in the moment of an urge.
What didn't — so you stop trying it.

slides.title: Write [[4–6]]
items: Your top 3 triggers — places, feelings, apps.
Who helped and how.
What changed — sleep, mood, focus, confidence.

slides.title: Why it [[matters]]
slides.body: In a month, you'll forget how you did it. A bad week in December will feel brand new. Your notes turn this November into a playbook against p*rn.

slides.title: Do it [[like this]]
items: One page, six headings.
Write it today, add to it until the 30th.
Photograph it so it's always on you.
Re-read it the first time you feel shaky.
slides.note: Save this and write your page tonight 🔖

slides.title:

carousels.name: 4 signs you're not quitting p*rn, just trying to feel better about it

slides.title: 4 signs you're not quitting p*rn — [[just trying to feel better about it.]]
You only [[feel guilty]]
slides.body: Guilt after. Same thing next week. Guilt without change is just part of the p*rn routine.

slides.title: You never change [[the setup]]
slides.body: Same phone in bed. Same late nights. Same private browser. Nothing changes if nothing changes.

slides.title: Signs [[3–4]]
items: You keep it secret so no one can hold you to it.
You have no goal — just "less p*rn, I guess."

slides.title: Actually [[quit]]
items: Set a start date — today counts.
Change one thing about your setup tonight.
Tell one person your goal.
Pick a number: 30, 60 or 90 days without p*rn.
slides.note: Be honest: which sign is you? Comment 1–4 👇

slides.title:
Less guilt. More change.
[[Start with RezenIt.]]
slides.lead: A p*rn blocker, real accountability and a step-by-step recovery program — an actual plan.

carousels.name: 6 relapse myths that turn one slip into a p*rn binge

slides.title: 6 relapse myths [[that turn one slip into a p*rn binge.]]
slides.sub: A slip doesn't mean what you think it means.

slides.title: Myths [[1–2]]
items: "I'm back to zero." The skills you built against p*rn didn't disappear.
"I never really wanted to quit." Wanting and slipping can both be true.

slides.title: Myths [[3–4]]
items: "Might as well binge now." That's the craving talking. Stop at one.
"Real quitters never slip." Many long-term quitters slipped plenty.

slides.title: Myths [[5–6]]
items: "I'll wait for a fresh start." Tomorrow is fine. Today is better.
"A relapse means failure." It's information about what to fix.

slides.title: After a [[slip]]
items: Stop — close it and leave the room.
Write down what led to the p*rn.
Fix one thing before bed.
Start again tomorrow morning, not next month.
slides.note: Save this for the night you need it 🔖

slides.title:
Slip. Learn.
[[Keep going.]]
slides.lead: Shame-free streaks, journaling to learn from every slip and a panic button for next time.

Missed one? Do it the next day — don't quit the list.
Bring a friend into it.

slides.title:
8 days. 8 wins.
[[Then keep going.]]
